known_cutoff_publicity_caveats: Google does not publish an exact training-data cutoff for Gemini 3.7 Flash; the structured cutoff remains unknown.

Gemini 3.7 Flash reached general availability on 2026-08-13, after the Cycle 1 corpus decision window closed and after the frozen Cycle 1 release anchor of 2026-06-26. This entry is supplementary: it must never be substituted into the frozen Cycle 1 registry, and its rows publish as supplementary_post_anchor rather than official.

This revision supersedes cycle-1-supplementary-gemini-3.7-flash-2026-08-24.json for official-parity execution. The prior revision remains immutable and records the completed local 16000-token no-tools comparison.
Execution settings mirror the frozen official four: controlled_docket_tool_only, max_output_tokens 128000, and an explicit maximum reasoning setting. Provider-default sampling remains in force.

thinking_level 'high' is the Gemini 3 successor to the deprecated numeric thinkingBudget and is the Google-side equivalent of the official OpenAI reasoning_effort 'high'. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/latest-model (migration checklist replaces thinking_budget with the thinking_level string enum) and https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.7-flash (supported levels low, medium, high; 'minimal' returns an error), both checked 2026-08-29.
